facts.abi_defines: Defines that change the library's ABI and must match between the library and every consumer.
facts.self_check: A call the library provides to verify consumer and library agree, if any.
facts.language_standard: The minimum C or C++ standard the library needs.
facts.exceptions_rtti: Whether the library needs exceptions or RTTI.

rules.text: Every library's self-check passes at startup, and the composition's language standard covers every library's minimum.
